purpose: Unreviewed full-coverage 3D marker-routing foundation for MeridianPoints.

requiredBeforeLearningUse: Have a qualified acupuncture/anatomy reviewer approve each projected point anchor.
Author curated comparison-marker relationships per learning screen.

axes.x: negative = asset anatomical-left convention; positive = asset anatomical-right convention

coordinateSpace.anchorMeaning: Raw route estimates are snapped to the nearest triangle of Skin_Body with its outward interpolated normal. Viewers apply marker.offsetAlongNormal.
coordinateSpace.mirrorPolicy: Bilateral routes are authored once on asset-left and mirrored across x = 0 to make concrete left/right instances.

coordinateStatus.estimated: Generated from route templates and snapped to the current Skin_Body mesh; not clinically or anatomically reviewed.

reviewStatus.needs-anatomical-and-model-fit-review: Requires anatomical review and fit validation against the final rendered body.
reviewStatus.not-approved-for-comparison-display: A geometric candidate only; do not render as a learning comparison marker.
reviewStatus.not-a-clinical-neighbour-claim: Sequence order is data ordering, not a localisation relationship.

SP_main:L.label: medial great toe to lateral chest

SP_main:R.label: medial great toe to lateral chest

BL_inner:L.label: inner paraspinal line to popliteal fossa

BL_inner:R.label: inner paraspinal line to popliteal fossa

BL_outer:L.label: outer back line to lateral fifth toe

BL_outer:R.label: outer back line to lateral fifth toe

LR_main:L.label: lateral great toe to sixth intercostal field

LR_main:R.label: lateral great toe to sixth intercostal field

CV_main:M.label: anterior midline from perineum to lower lip

GV_main:M.label: posterior midline from perineum over scalp to upper gum
